wiki.title: Jacinda Morigeau
wiki.extract: Jacinda Morigeau is an American politician serving in the Montana Senate from the 46th district. First elected in 2024, she is a member of the Democratic Party. Morigeau is Bitterroot Salish and a citizen of the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes.
